name: CHEAP_FLIGHTS_MCP
description: MCP server for searching cheap flights in real-time. Searches RyanAir, WizzAir and Google Flights simultaneously using asyncio.gather for parallel queries. Includes Web UI, AI Agent (Claude via SAP Hyperspace), exponential backoff retry, USD/EUR conversion, and verified booking deep links.
author: Robert Fodor

tools.name: search_flights
tools.description: Search for flights between two airports. Returns cheapest flights from all active airlines sorted by price. Supports one-way and return flights.

parameters.origin: IATA airport code (e.g. BTS, VIE, BUD)
parameters.destination: IATA airport code (e.g. STN, LTN, BCN)

tools.name: list_active_airlines
tools.description: Show currently active airlines used for searching (ryanair, wizzair, google_flights).

tools.name: add_airline
tools.description: Add an airline to the active search list.

parameters.airline_code: Airline code: ryanair, wizzair, or google_flights

tools.name: remove_airline
tools.description: Remove an airline from the active search list.

parameters.airline_code: Airline code: ryanair, wizzair, or google_flights

tools.name: get_destinations
tools.description: Get all available flight destinations from an airport (including seasonal routes).
